title: A Forest Out of Place
description:
Some forests do not belong to this world. Their paths branch toward ruins and creatures that expect preparation rather than courage alone.

This is an introductory reading entry ONLY. It does not claim the dimension was entered, a boss was defeated, a relic was equipped, or any reward has been earned. Runtime-verified item/structure objectives will be authored later.

Field note: Do not assume the first boss is optional to a specific Twilight portal progression gate until verified.
